title: Retrieved but Not Read: Understanding Why Search-Augmented LLMs Fail to Use Available Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.21731v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Web search allows LLMs to access up-to-date information, but it remains unclear why they sometimes produce outdated answers even when relevant evidence is available. To study this problem, we construct temporal facts whose values changed after the models' training cutoffs. We evaluate one proprietary model under deployed web search and six open-weight model configurations under controlled retrieval. We find that models often answer from search snippets without opening the source pages, which is associated with higher rates of outdated answers and unfaithful citations. Our controlled experiments and layer-wise analysis reveal a gap between the availability of evidence and its effective use. Even when retrieved evidence influences internal predictions, models may still favour outdated information in their final answers. We hope these findings will help advance research on the reliable use of retrieved evidence in search-augmented LLMs.

translated_title: 已检索但未阅读：理解搜索增强型大语言模型为何无法利用可用证据
translated_abstract: 网络搜索使大语言模型（LLM）能够获取最新信息，但为什么它们在相关证据可用时有时仍会产生过时的答案，这一点尚不清楚。为了研究这个问题，我们构建了在模型训练截止日期之后其值发生变化的时间性事实。我们评估了一个部署网络搜索的专有模型，以及在受控检索条件下测试的六个开源权重模型配置。我们发现，模型经常只根据搜索摘要作答而不打开源网页，这与更高的过时答案率和不可信引用率相关。我们的受控实验和逐层分析揭示了证据可用性与有效利用之间的差距：即使检索到的证据已经影响了模型的内部预测，模型在最终答案中仍可能偏向过时的信息。我们希望这些发现有助于推进关于搜索增强型大语言模型中可靠使用检索证据的研究。
tldr: 本研究揭示了搜索增强型大语言模型的失效机制：模型常只凭搜索摘要作答而不阅读源网页，且即使检索证据已影响内部预测，最终答案仍可能偏向过时信息。
en_tdlr: This study reveals why search-augmented LLMs fail: they often answer from snippets without reading source pages, and even when retrieved evidence influences internal predictions, models may still favor outdated information in their final answers.
